mean: to work together in perfect sync
lit: breaths match: two people breathing in the same rhythm

use.how: Said of partners or a team doing something together: 二人は息が合う, 息の合ったプレー. It needs a shared activity where timing matters.

near.diff: 気が合う is liking each other's personality; 息が合う is moving or working in step during a joint activity.

cue: Two dancers who met only a month ago move so perfectly together on stage that the audience assumes they have partnered for years. What can you say about them?
